{{TOC|side}}
{{GameCategory|tkoh|link= y}} presents the players with a powerful - and sometimes overwhelming - Editor. 

The goal of this section is to introduce new players to the basics, and show some veteran users a little of the new features introduced by this project.

* Below you will find a step-by-step guide to creating {{Link|Take On Helicopters: Sample Mission 1|sample mission 1}}
* You can find and download the scenario itself {{Link|http://takeonthegame.com/take-on-editing/|here}}!
** ''note, unzip the file, and put the directory:''<code style="display: block">SampleMission.United_States_H</code>''into your TKOH user profile's mission directory:''<code style="display: block">[USER]\Documents\Take On Helicopters\missions\</code>
* We also used this scenario as the basis for a video guide, which you can find here: {{Link|http://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}wcSgRoSJGZk}}
* Once you've completed part one, we've created {{Link|Take On Helicopters: Sample Mission 2|sample mission 2}}
** Part 2 builds upon this mission, and introduces more advanced techniques!
